notes: Parse layer (pinned v0.80.0 card-data.json, parse_evidence.json): Tolsimir's Wolf-enter trigger execute = GainLife{3} only; the 'fights up to one target creature you don't control' clause has no sub_ability and no target definition. Matches triage: 'its child structure contains only GainLife'.
Runtime layer: the trigger instantiated on the stack carried effect GainLife{3}, sub_ability null, targets [], optional_targeting false -- the fight half never reached the stack.
Full waiting_for sequence for the game: MulliganDecision, DeclareAttackers, Priority only. No target-selection wait was ever opened, so the controller was never offered the fight.
2+ legal fight targets (Grizzly Bears x2 on P1 battlefield) were present at trigger time, so a missing prompt cannot be explained by single-target auto-targeting or lack of legal targets.
Life gain occurred (20->23) exactly as reported; only the fight half is broken.

The live tick's stack scanner missed the trigger (description nests under kind.data.ability on protocol 69); scenario_6889.py patched for future runs. The observation itself is direct from mid_trigger.json.
Verdict rationale: the reported outcome (fight never offered or resolved while life gain works) is exactly reproduced on v0.80.0.
